adjudication.rationale: The diff removes the site-wide `embed_category` setting (deleted from `config/site_settings.yml` and `server.en.yml`) and changes `TopicEmbed.import` to set `PostCreator`'s `category` from `eh = EmbeddableHost.record_for_host(url)` via `category: eh.try(:category_id)` (app/models/topic_embed.rb). If `record_for_host` returns nil (e.g., imported URL host not present in `embeddable_hosts`), the category passed becomes nil; there is no fallback to the old configured category. The migration also deletes both `embeddable_hosts` and `embed_category` site settings after attempting to create rows, meaning an instance with `embed_category` set but no `embeddable_hosts` rows created will lose that configuration entirely. This is a behavior regression that can route embeds into the default/uncategorized category (or otherwise not into the previously configured category).
